title: heare Phase A — Observable Actions
notes: Fix D2 (empty action summary from Agent SDK) + D3 (no audio feedback). Scope is intentionally narrow: make intent execution observable. Prompt hardening, confirmation gate, and SDK split are deferred to Phase B/C/D.

stories.title: AgentSDKCLI captures tool-use output
stories.description: _run_query must collect ToolResultBlock content from UserMessage in addition to AssistantMessage.TextBlock so bash stdout reaches the returned summary.
acceptanceCriteria: src/agent_sdk_cli.py _attempt_query iterates UserMessage and ToolResultBlock, appending content.text-like strings to stdout_chunks (order: message arrival order).
ToolResultBlock.content can be str or list[dict]; both shapes extract plain text safely without raising.
ToolResultBlock with is_error=True still contributes to stdout_chunks (so caller sees the error text).

Unit test in tests/test_agent_sdk_cli.py drives a scripted SDK transcript: AssistantMessage(TextBlock 'ok'), AssistantMessage(ToolUseBlock), UserMessage(ToolResultBlock 'hi'), AssistantMessage(TextBlock 'done') and asserts the returned string contains both 'hi' and 'done'.
Existing tests in tests/test_agent_sdk_cli.py continue to pass after the change.

stories.title: Spoken summary after successful action
stories.description: When ActionWorker reports success, the pipeline pushes a short Ukrainian TTSSpeakFrame so the user hears the result. Empty summaries fall back to a generic confirmation phrase.
acceptanceCriteria: src/main.py _on_action_result pushes a TTSSpeakFrame through the processor for every successful action.
If summary has content, spoken text is the first ~120 chars (cleaned, one line). If summary is empty, spoken text is the fallback 'Готово.'
Scrubber patterns from src/generator.py are applied so JSON/tool fragments never reach TTS.
Structured log entry '[ACTION SPEAK id=X len=Y]' records how many chars were spoken for debuggability.
No pipecat import crash on machines without pipecat — pushes via processor.push_frame which the pipeline already provides.

stories.title: Spoken hint after failed action
stories.description: When ActionWorker reports an error (timeout or exception), the pipeline pushes a short Ukrainian TTSSpeakFrame so the user hears the failure.
acceptanceCriteria: src/main.py _on_action_error pushes a TTSSpeakFrame with a short Ukrainian error hint (e.g. 'Не вийшло: <type>').
TimeoutError produces the phrase 'Дія не встигла, скасовую.' (no traceback text).
Other exceptions produce 'Не вдалося — <exception-class-name>.'
Structured log entry '[ACTION ERROR SPEAK id=X kind=...]' records the hint that was spoken.

stories.title: Integration test covers observable action loop
stories.description: tests/integration/test_intent_flow.py grows to assert both the success-speech and error-speech paths.
acceptanceCriteria: New test test_intent_flow_emits_result_speech simulates a successful action, asserts on_result pushes a TTSSpeakFrame containing the summary prefix or the fallback phrase.
New test test_intent_flow_emits_error_speech simulates a timeout, asserts on_error pushes a TTSSpeakFrame with the timeout hint.
Existing test_end_to_end_intent_submission_and_execution continues to pass unchanged.
Tests run via uv run pytest tests/integration/test_intent_flow.py and exit 0.

stories.title: Regression + lint green
stories.description: Full test suite and lint must be clean after Phase A changes.
acceptanceCriteria: uv run pytest tests/ exits 0 with zero failures.
ruff check . exits 0 on all touched files (src/agent_sdk_cli.py, src/main.py, tests/**).
progress.txt records files touched, patterns learned, and a short 'how to live-verify' note.
